policyText: Spend no more than $25 in any seven day period. Never send more than $5 in a single payment. Only top up when the balance falls below 3 meals. Only ever pay the merchant on my approved list. If a day's usage is more than twice the trailing weekly average, do nothing and tell me. After any payment, wait at least 6 hours before making another.

intents.statement: Do not spend more than $25 in any seven day period.

undefinedTerms.why: The reference window and calculation method are not defined, so different reasonable interpretations could change when the condition triggers.
It is unclear what counts toward usage and how it is measured.
The balance type and measurement basis are not defined, and this affects when top-ups are allowed.
The unit 'meals' is not defined, so the threshold depends on an unspecified conversion or valuation.
The contents and update authority for the approved merchant list are not defined.

openQuestions: What constitutes a seven day period for the spending cap: rolling window, calendar week, or some other interval?
Does 'top up' count as spending toward the $25 cap and the $5 single-payment cap?
What exactly should the agent do if the user's usage condition is triggered but the user cannot be reached?
Are payments to the same merchant aggregated for the single-payment limit or treated separately if split?
